tools.name: world_time
tools.description:
Current local time, date, weekday, UTC offset and daylight-saving status for any city, country or time zone in the world (any language: "Tokyo", "東京", "Brasil", "America/New_York", "UTC+3"). Countries with several time zones return each zone.
Use when: someone asks what time it is somewhere, or you

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description:
Converts a local time from one place to one or more other places, handling daylight saving on that date (meeting planning).
Use when: "15:00 in Paris is what time in New York?", "schedule a call at 9 am San Francisco for London and Tokyo".
Example: {"time":"15:00","from":"Paris","to":["New York","To
